_comment: marble_tower: Map 2's guard tower, the Bentham drawing's -- ONE round stone shaft of constant diameter (r 7.0) on two low steps rising from the spike floor, opening at the guard floor into an ARCADE (pass 5, Ryan: the drawing's columns are arches, not just props under a dome): sixteen 0.30 m columns at bearings 25 + 22.5k, each rising 3.20 m from the room floor to a springing at z 4.90, JOINED BY SIXTEEN ROUND ARCHES of span 2.43 and rise 1.22 whose crowns stand at 6.12 on the facet corner lines, with a 0.88 m spandrel over each crown; the arches carry the ring beam (7.00..7.50, no exposed underside -- the arcade's head is solid corner to corner) and the dome (7.5..12.9) on top of it. The sixteen arched openings are still centred on 36.25 + 22.5k, so TowerVariant's 43 deg plugs at 25 + 45k are unchanged. A 1.2 m balcony ledge round the shaft, FLAT with the room floor at z 1.70, with a 1.0 m railing of 32 iron posts, a mid and a top rail (rail top 2.70, under the guard's sight line from the 0.6 m dais to the lane). Origin = the guard-room datum as tower.glb: the room floor is z 1.70, the guard's eye 3.95 on the dais, the foot z -26.35 (the spike floor, world y -1.0, when the scene's Tower node stands at y 25.35). One material, marble's packed 256 px atlas: fluting on the columns and their arch panels, coursed stone in the spandrels, shade in the jamb reveals and the arch soffits. MarbleTowerCollision rides in the .glb as a `-colonly` node (foot, steps, shaft, slab, ledge, an invisible band at r 8.12 from 1.70 to 2.70 in place of the railing, room floor, plain full-height column boxes -- a body cannot walk into an arch's head, so the collider keeps the cheap colonnade and its flat soffit -- and the ring beam closed with a flat ceiling; the dome is out of reach); Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` counts only what is drawn. max_tris 4700: the arcade is 4380 tris -- the sixteen pierced screens (two faces, jamb reveals, arch soffits, spandrel strips) cost 1152 of them and the beam's two station-split faces 384, against 128 + 192 for pass 4's bare columns and soffit; the railing (32 posts, two rails) is the other big line.
